The outcome of a ColumnReader batch read.

public BatchRead(int Entries, int Values)

Parameters

Entries int

The number of level entries read; 0 means the column chunk has no more. An entry is a row for a column that is not repeated; in a repeated column it is one value, null or empty list, and a row can span several entries.

Values int

The number of non-null values among them (equal to Entries for a required column).
